description: Source code for the regulator driver for the NXP PCA9420 device in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration structures, and driver implementation functions.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_count_voltages
methods.description: Counts the number of available voltage settings based on linear ranges.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_list_voltage
methods.description: Lists a specific voltage value based on index.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_set_voltage
methods.description: Sets the voltage within specified min and max microvolts.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_get_current_limit
methods.description: Gets the current limit in microamperes.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_get_active_discharge
methods.description: Checks if active discharge is enabled.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_dvs_state_set
methods.description: Sets the DVS (Dynamic Voltage Scaling) state.

methods.name: regulator_pca9420_common_init
methods.description: Common initialization routine for the regulator.
